grain_rationale: The profile shows 44721 rows with a duplicate_row_rate of 0.0, and the samples read as individual invoice line items (one invoice_id carrying many stock_code lines, each with its own quantity and unit_price), so one source row is one event and the grain is transaction. No single column is unique on its own (invoice_id has 2330 distinct values and stock_code 3141 against 44721 rows), so a derived identity over the tuple invoice_id, stock_code, invoiced_at, quantity, unit_price identifies a line; with zero exact duplicates in the source, this tuple absorbs the identity without requiring aggregation.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Invoice document identifier grouping lines into one transaction, shown by sequential sample values like 489434 through 489443 with 2330 distinct invoices across 44721 rows and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Flag marking whether the line belongs to a cancellation, with exactly two distinct values (true, false), null_rate 0.0, and consistent with negative quantity samples such as -1395.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: Product code identifying the item sold on the line, with 3141 distinct alphanumeric codes such as 10002R and 10123C and null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Free-text product description such as '12 DAISY PEGS IN WOOD BOX'; nullable with a null_rate of 0.005098 (228 nulls), likely where a stock_code was recorded without catalog text.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Units sold on the line, an additive quantity ranging from -1395 to 5184 where negative samples represent cancellations or returns; null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the invoice event; samples such as 2009-12-01T07:45:00 resolve to the minute with zero seconds, spanning 2009-12-01 to 2009-12-23 with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Price per unit on the line, ranging from 0.00 to 1998.49 with null_rate 0.0; zero-price samples suggest free or adjustment lines.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Numeric customer identifier (12346 to 18287, 1045 distinct) that labels rather than measures; nullable with a null_rate of 0.300664, consistent with guest or unregistered purchases.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Customer country for the invoice, with 24 distinct values such as Australia, EIRE, and Germany and null_rate 0.0.

category_description: One row is one invoice line: a single product (stock_code) sold or cancelled in a given quantity at a given unit_price on one invoice (invoice_id) at one minute-resolved timestamp (invoiced_at), attributed to an optional customer and a country.
purpose: This mapping declares how silver.silver_invoice_lines enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category: the time column and its minute grain, the transaction grain with a derived line identity, and the role of every mapped silver column. Its sole consumer is the deterministic modeling engine, which renders the gold models from it.
usage: The proposal is rendered by deterministic code into an ODCS mapping contract draft (gold_invoice_lines_mapping), validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, gated by the validator and datacontract lint, and reviewed and edited by a human before approval; nothing in this proposal executes directly.
limitations: The mapping does not transform, filter, or derive columns beyond the declared line identity: rows with is_cancellation true and negative quantity samples (down to -1395) are mapped as-is, and excluding or netting them is left to consumers; the 30.07% null customer_id rows are retained without imputation; zero unit_price lines are not filtered; and no quality rules, severities, classifications, service levels, ownership, or access policies are proposed, as those belong to review.
